highlights.title: Qwen in Add a provider
highlights.line: Add a provider now offers Qwen, run on this computer through Ollama or at an address you give, and asks before a large download.

highlights.title: An agent says when a plugin cannot reach it
highlights.line: When a plugin you added in your own Claude or Codex app cannot reach an agent, its page says so, and says restarting will not help.

highlights.title: Agents asking about imports say so
highlights.line: When a Claude agent is stopped on Claude Code's allow external imports question, its card now says that is what it is asking.

highlights.title: The Agents list fits a narrow window
highlights.line: In a narrow browser window, the Agents list shows each running agent's role and AI model under its name, not cut short.

highlights.title: Quiet runs of a recurring task roll up
highlights.line: Runs of a recurring task that found nothing new, or repeated the same note, fold into one row; its card says when something last changed.
